snippet.description:
Former Wisconsin gubernatorial candidate Francesca Hong talks to Vox’s Astead Herndon about how criticism of her campaign overlooked the everyday people organizing for change — ultimately leading to her losing the race. 

Watch this week’s episode of America, Actually here on YouTube or listen wherever you get your podcasts on Saturday.
